notes.title: Update 1.1 - The Pop Dash!
notes.content:
Hey! it's been a while! To be honest, I decided to update the game on a whim. I hope that it improves your experience of the game!

[h1]New Area[/h1]

A new area has been placed after the second boss of the game. It's not particularly hidden, but it shouldn't be to easy to find! 

The area itself is a dark lab - nobody is home and the only things there are death and the new upgrade, seemingly used to help speed up their work!

[h1]New Upgrade[/h1]

This new upgrade is in the name of the update - the Pop dash!

The pop dash allows you to dash by pressing down and sprint at the same time - moving you so fast that you leave explosions in your wake! It's so fast, that you can't even see yourself going from one spot to the other! 

[h1]Other News[/h1]

A camera track in the last area was incorrectly set to scroll on the x-axis rather than the y-axis. this has been fixed and should make the area easier to navigate.
